remarks: Beautifully updated corner-unit townhouse in the desirable Oak Hill Condominium community on a quiet West Norwalk cul-de-sac. This move-in-ready home offers stunning sunrise and pool views, abundant natural light, and modern upgrades throughout. The renovated kitchen features white shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a powder room. Hardwood floors extend through the open living and dining areas, with sliding doors leading to a spacious deck overlooking the pool and landscaped grounds. Upstairs are two generously sized bedrooms with custom built-in storage and a renovated full bath featuring heated stone tile floors. The lower level offers a flexible heated-floor bonus room ideal for a home office, gym, playroom, or guest space, plus ample storage and patio access. Additional highlights include an attached garage, newer washer and dryer, brand-new windows with a 20-year warranty, new central A/C, and easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, parks, and Oak Hills Golf Course. Schedule your showing today! The seller is requesting the highest and best offers by Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 12:00 PM (noon).
